Good morning. It's Thursday, August 13. Here's your pre-market briefing.

Turning to the overnight tape. The S&P 500 closed at 7,748.50, up 0.26%. The
Nasdaq Composite added 0.54%. In Asia, the Nikkei gained 1.63%.

On rates. The two-year sits at 4.20%, down 2 basis points. The ten-year is at
4.68%. Breadth was narrow, with only 42.7% of S&P constituents advancing on the
session, a reading that has preceded consolidation before.

That's your briefing. Have a good one.
